newsitem.title: USA: Guidant declines on offering cancellation.
newsitem.headline: Guidant declines on offering cancellation.

text.p: Guidant Corp slipped 1-1/8 to 43-1/4 on Friday as the market reacted to the company's cancellation of a secondary equity offering.
The shares had been down more sharply at midday, but recovered some ground near the close as some investors said they sensed a buying opportunity.

"The company is in the midst of a slower growth phase and didn't want to sell into it. They should pull out of it next year ... This is an opportunity," said J.P. Morgan medical technology analyst Michael Weinstein.

Guidant declined to comment. The company said in a statement earlier that it had cancelled a secondary equity offering due to the reduced value of its stock since its October 14 release of third-quarter financial results.
Shares in the Indianapolis-based medical devices manufacturer traded above 55 as recently as late September.
